items.text: Four PBs this week — Tom's SkiErg finally behaved and Aisha made the row look easy.
Three new starters on Thursday — if you see a lost face, you're the welcome committee now.
Big five-oh for Mel on Saturday — she's requested wall balls instead of cake. We're doing both.
London entries close Wednesday — the sheet's by the desk, put your name down.
Half the morning crew is talking about a doubles team-up — partner board's live, claim your lane.
And Katie — happy birthday for Tuesday. Your 7am's in the book; I'll bring the coffee and croissants on the way in.

followUp.text: The pic: me and Katie, coffee and croissants after the 7am. I keep my promises.
